_note: Stats from the register sheets. Gaps derived by SRD 5.1 rules and logged in invented.json. Level-up picks (spells, subclasses) are the build's, PROPOSED. HP: every level is a max hit die plus CON (RULED 09-25, Griz), so level 2 = 2 x (die + CON): Barley 26, Aurdin 12, Vivian 18, Lymen 24.

barley.name: Barley
barley.blurb: A Dominion farm wanderer with a threshing flail. He went down once against Cutter on fight night and got back up. Ten silver in his fist and a name that isn't his.

featText.t: Indomitable (reroll a failed save, once a day)

feats: Remarkable Athlete: quicker off the mark (initiative).
Indomitable: once a day, a failed save is rolled again.

barley.note: His true name is withheld by the law of the tongue.

aurdin.name: Aurdin
aurdin.blurb: Sixteen, INT 17, WIS 9: he knows, and asks the wrong people. A farm boy off Newland who walked away from the sun chapels, came in with the Glowseep crews' haul, and slept on Aldwin's floor.

feats: Potent Cantrip: a foe who saves against a cantrip still takes half.

aurdin.note: Canon: wizard 1. Level 2 is this game's only.
aurdin.srdBook: RULED 10-01c (Griz: "match SRD expectations when possible"): the SRD wizard's count -- 3 cantrips and 8 spells at 2, two a level after, a 4th cantrip at 4; js/rules.js migrate teaches an older save what is due

vivian.name: Vivian
vivian.blurb: Marta Venn's daughter, about twenty-two. Not a thief who learned to watch: a watcher who learned to steal. The candle girl on the east side, and one of the fingers at the Hex on card nights.

featText.t: Sneak Attack (an ally engaged, or advantage)
Cunning Action: HIDE before or after her attack (bonus action)
Thief: Fast Hands (ITEM is a bonus action)
Cutthroat: Opening Cut (first round: advantage on a foe that hasn't acted; a hit is a critical)

feats: Evasion: a DEX save for half takes none, and a failed one takes half.
Supreme Sneak: she stays hidden longer.

archetypes.name: Thief
archetypes.desc: Fast Hands. Using an item is a bonus action: a potion, a kit, a torch, and still her attack.

archetypes.name: Cutthroat
archetypes.desc: Opening Cut. In the first round, advantage against any foe that hasn't acted yet, and a hit on it is a critical.
archetypes.src: original to this game (the canon lean is Assassin, which is not in the SRD 5.1); invented.json#cutthroat

vivian.note: Her archetype is the player's choice at level 3 (RULED 09-24). The canon lean is Assassin; the SRD has only Thief, so the second path is this game's own.

lymen.name: Lymen
lymen.blurb: Warda's son, twenty-four. Self-ordained under Kalindel, the generative nature of the planet, in a town outside Newland's writ. Chain mail from the show-armorer: stage work outside, honest steel under.

featText.t: Lay on Hands (5 per level; 5 cures a poison)
Aura of Protection (+CHA to the party's saves)

feats: Aura of Protection: while Lymen stands, the party adds his CHA to saves.
Aura of Devotion: the party cannot be charmed.

lymen.note: The Urtusk family is Griz's. The sheet reads AC 18; the rules make it 19 (flagged).

brann.name: Brann
brann.blurb: Young; the last of a family the highway wiped out at Third Lamp.
brann.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.4 (the escorts: veteran stat block AC 17 HP 58, dwarf traits); §6.2 (guests); names PROPOSED

hedda.name: Hedda
hedda.blurb: A Greyseam in the garrison. Her orders end at Third Lamp.

ingrith.name: Ingrith

featText.t: Disciple of Life: her healing spells heal 2 + the slot's level more
Channel Divinity: Preserve Life, Turn Undead

ingrith.blurb: The keeper of Solskaft's ledger, going down to her clan.
ingrith.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 9 (the Cleric goes down to Deepholm with the party as her escort); a guest who heals (the build's); RULED 09-28g (Griz: "Yes, she's meant to be Cleric"): cleric 4 in both games -- the SRD's average HP by the d8 (31), slots 4/3, the drafted list (spells-srd-by-class.md) and the Life Domain's Spiritual Weapon; Life Domain the seat's (invented.json #ingrith-cleric)

pyro.name: Pyro
pyro.blurb: Solskaft's only king, at the vault door. Ran with Winters and Tarlyn in the Orc War, and likes adventurers.
pyro.src: wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md (Pyronimus, fighter 9); wiki/solskaft.md (dual-wields hand maces: CANON 09-26c); handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-spine-recut.md §2 beat 2 (sheet PROPOSED: Two-Weapon Fighting, mace in each hand, Extra Attack, Second Wind, Action Surge, Indomitable; HP ~85; RULED 09-26d fighter 9). attacks 3 = Extra Attack's two and the off-hand's one. RULED 09-30 (Griz: 'Gonna have to Pyro NPC up to 12, he's key'; the Mace of Disruption in his off-hand) and 09-30b ('+3 dwarven plate, and a cloak +5 to saves vs spells'; the off-hand style, five swings at 12): fighter 12, the Champion, STR 20 by the 12th's ASI (the seat's), HP 112 (the 9's average on); attacks 3 = Extra Attack at 5 and 11, the off-hand's in js/pyro.js and deep16/js/pyro.js (his measure: every fight he walks in)

halldor.name: Halldor
halldor.blurb: A captain of the garrison. Took a unit up the north cut after something that came through the wall.
halldor.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-spine-recut.md §2 beat 3 (Captain Halldor Silversands, RULED 09-26d: 'sounds fun'); sheet PROPOSED

trooper.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-spine-recut.md §2 beats 3 and 5 (the captain's unit); sheet PROPOSED

dace.name: Dace
dace.blurb: The house's ambitious grandson: forty-four, and the book a year old. He has wanted the deep gallery all his life.
dace.src: TarlynsPit/npcs-by-location.md CORWEN DACE (CANON 09-22: Wizard 1, rolled -- AC 12, 15 with mage armor; HP 7; light, sleep, mage armor among his); RULED 10-01c (Griz: the escort to the cloaker cavern -- 'game over if the kid falls, cloaker focuses on kid'); the 8-bit's spells of his only (mage hand, minor illusion, alarm, feather fall unbuilt)
